title: MS-Exam-Gen: An Automatic Benchmark Construction Toolkit for Evaluating LLMs on Multiple Sclerosis-MRI Imaging Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2610.06170v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. translated_title: MS-Exam-Gen：用于评估大语言模型多发性硬化症MRI影像知识的自动基准构建工具包
translated_abstract: 生物医学大语言模型（LLM）的评估需要对狭窄、不断演进、以文献为依据的亚专科知识进行可审计的测评。多发性硬化MRI（MS-MRI）提供了一个高风险的文本知识测试案例，因为正确的推理需要掌握现行诊断标准、标准化采集与报告知识、纵向监测概念、病灶形态学以及对疑难模仿病变的识别能力。我们提出了MS-Exam-Gen，一个用于构建和审计基于文本的多发性硬化MRI知识多选题（MCQ）基准的可复现框架；它并不评估直接的MRI图像解读。MS-Exam-Gen针对以文献为依据的诊断标准、检查方案、报告和鉴别诊断。该框架结合了专家文献索引、面向考试的主题归纳、以证据为依据的多选题生成、自动化质量审计、同族一致性筛查以及经验校准。基于66个文献来源……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了MS-Exam-Gen，一个可复现的自动基准构建工具包，通过结合文献索引、主题归纳、证据驱动的多选题生成与自动化质量审计，构建并审计基于文献依据的多发性硬化MRI知识多选题基准，以评估生物医学大语言模型的亚专科知识水平。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible automatic benchmark construction toolkit that generates and audits source-grounded multiple-choice questions to evaluate biomedical LLMs on multiple sclerosis MRI knowledge.
